caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with armrests, shown from a frontal view, centered within a rectangular frame on a light background. The chair features a red-brown wooden frame with yellow accents along the edges and joints. The backrest includes three horizontal wooden slats, the topmost being solid, the middle with three circular details, and the bottom one simple and rectangular. The armrests are curved and extend outward from the back of the chair, connecting to the front legs. The seat is made of interwoven rush or straw, rendered in shades of yellow and brown, forming a diamond-shaped pattern radiating from the center. The legs are turned and carved with a spindle design, and there is a decorative spindle stretcher connecting the front legs near the floor, matching the wooden color scheme. The artist’s name appears in small text at the bottom left of the inner frame.
title: Chair
